displayName: Early Alert triage-monitor stopped - no tick logged for 45 minutes

conditions.displayName: triage-monitor has not written a tick line for 45 minutes

documentation.content:
The triage-silence monitor (Cloud Run service triage-monitor) has not logged a tick for 45 minutes. It normally runs every 5 minutes from Cloud Scheduler job triage-monitor-tick. While it is stopped, nobody is watching whether triage determinations are being made.

Check, in order: the Scheduler job is enabled and running; the service's latest revision is serving; the service's logs for an error line.

What the monitor checks: the triage table in BigQuery (early-alert-responses.RESPONSES.triage-message-data), the latest determination_time against requests with no determination.
